question: According to _______ law, heat produced by an electric current is directly proportional to the resistance of the conductor, the square of the current, and the time for which it flows.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Joule's.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Joule's law** states that the amount of heat produced in a conductor is directly proportional to the** resistance **of the conductor, the **square of the current**, and the** time **for which it flows. 
 
• This law is also known as the **law of heating or the Joule-Lenz law.**
 
• The law is important in the study of **electrical circuits,** as it helps to determine the amount of **heat generated** in the circuit, which can affect the performance and safety of the circuit.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Hooke's law** states that the force required to extend or compress a spring is directly proportional to the **distance of extension or compression.**
 
• **Charles's law **states that the **volume of a gas** is directly proportional to its **absolute temperature **at constant pressure.
 
• **Faraday's law **states that the **electromotive force (EMF)** induced in a closed circuit is directly proportional to the rate of change of** magnetic flux** through the circuit.
